0022600147.text: The Utah Jazz (1-3, 13th in the West, 5th in the Northwest and 3 games back) host the Portland Trail Blazers (3-0, 3rd in the West and 0.5 games back in the Northwest) in the Jazz's sixth game of the season, with Utah on a two-game losing streak and Portland on a three-game winning streak. Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), Lauri Markkanen (wrist) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), while Portland is without Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Jazz lost all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently 124-114 in Portland on March 13, 2026.
